what: topics whose PICO names a harm outcome and which publish neither a synthesis of it nor a reasoned refusal
_frozen_utc_note: H.ratchet stamps a hardcoded 2026-08-28 on every freeze file it creates. Corrected here to the date this class was actually frozen. The hardcode is in shared code this lane does not own and is left for its owner.
_what_a_PASS_means: With zero frozen keys a PASS now means what it appears to mean: no topic whose PICO names a harm outcome is missing one. That was NOT true before 2026-09-03 and the distinction is why this file exists.
_retired_2026_09_03: apixaban-vte-prophylaxis and apixaban-vte-treatment both publish a major_bleeding outcome as of 2026-09-03. The ratchet reported them RETIRED; retired entries are reported and never required, so the freeze goes to zero and the class is now clean. ANY future instance is NEW and the gate refuses it.
